# MyCampusKart

> India's verified student marketplace — buy, sell, exchange, and rent items inside your campus. Includes PG/room listings, student blog, and per-campus marketplace pages.

MyCampusKart is a Gen-Z friendly campus marketplace for Indian college students. Listings cover textbooks, electronics, bicycles, hostel essentials, and PG/hostel rentals. The platform also publishes a content hub with student-focused guides and per-campus landing pages.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured listings and category entry points.
- [Browse Marketplace](/browse): Full marketplace grid with category, price, and PG filters.
- [Blog Hub](/blog): Student guides, campus tips, marketplace tutorials.
- [Campuses](/campuses): Index of per-campus marketplace landing pages.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top student sellers and trust badges.
- [Download App](/downloadmycampuskartapp): Install the MyCampusKart PWA.
- [About](/about): What MyCampusKart is and who it's for.
- [Help](/help): Buyer and seller help center.
- [Shipping & Meetup](/shipping): How campus meetups and handoffs work.
- [Report](/report): Report a listing or user.

## Content

- [Blog post template](/blog/): Dynamic — see /sitemap.xml for the full list of published posts.
- [Campus pages](/campus/): Dynamic — per-college marketplace pages indexed in the sitemap.
- [Item listings](/item/): Dynamic product detail pages, one per active listing.
- [PG listings](/pg/): Dynamic accommodation detail pages.

## Optional

- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
